anchor.note: The identity matrix is standard matrix notation covered by the first course in linear algebra (matrices, matrix product, invertibility).
The Theta notation is listed among the aliases of the big-Omega and big-Theta concept but with no meaning given for the symbol, and this page does not say what Theta(log n) denotes here.

gaps.note: The page asserts that a transform has Theta(log n) levels of butterflies but never says how the layers are built or why their number is logarithmic, so the reader cannot check the claim from what the page gives.
